body.p: This disclosure is related to a robot motion control method and apparatus. The method

includes: obtaining a center-of-mass reference trajectory used for guiding the robot to execute a target motion; obtaining, based on optimization of an objective function, center-of-mass control information for controlling the robot to follow the center-of-mass reference trajectory to move; generating joint control information according to the center-of-mass control information and a structure matrix of the robot; and controlling the robot to execute the target motion based on the joint control information.
